title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Dark Crusade — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Dark Crusade did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Dark Crusade is the second expansion to the real-time strategy video game Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War developed by Relic Entertainment and published by THQ. Based on Games Workshop's tabletop wargame, Warhammer 40,000, Dark Crusade was released on October 9, 2006.

Nobody designed the part of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Dark Crusade you experience — it was inherited. The player may pick a faction to play as, and then engages in turn-based combat with the other A.I.-controlled factions. There are multiple provinces, which are conquered by fighting a regular skirmish match over them.
